rules: Prospect entries are not approved partnerships or connected catalogues.
Do not display product prices, stock, images or delivery promises until received from a permitted live source.
Never store network secrets, API tokens, feed bearer tokens or merchant credentials in this public registry.
A retailer directory link is not a product feed integration.
Affiliate orders are completed by the retailer; HI FASHION first-party seller checkout is separate.
